scope: Exhaustive witness enumeration + canonical motif clustering across all six existing Type-B candidate databases (B20, B20D2, gap2_e29, gap1_e29, gap2_e30, gap1_e30), performed to search for a common structural forcing mechanism. Does not assert any all-orders theorem.

B20.geometry: 19 vertices, path p0..p17 (a=p0, y=p17), off-path vertex z=18

B20D2.geometry: 19 vertices, full spanning path p0..p18 (a=p0, y=p18), no off-path vertex

gap2_e29.geometry: 20 vertices, path p0..p18 (a=p0, y=p18), off-path vertex z=19

gap1_e29.geometry: 20 vertices, path p0..p17 (a=p0, y=p17), off-path vertices z1=18, z2=19

gap2_e30.geometry: same as gap2_e29, E=30 (five degree-excess sub-cases, only B3 realizable)

gap1_e30.geometry: same as gap1_e29, E=30 (five degree-excess sub-cases, only B3 realizable)

headline_reconfirmation.method: exhaustive re-enumeration of ALL simple C16 cycles and ALL simple a-y paths of length 6 and 14 per candidate, independent of the single witness previously recorded per candidate in the existing witness JSON files
headline_reconfirmation.result: across all 1936 candidates: C4 count=0, C8 count=0, length-2 a-y path count=0, and every candidate has at least one internal C16 witness, at least one length-6 a-y path, and at least one length-14 a-y path (stronger than the previously-recorded disjunctive claim: all three hold simultaneously in every candidate)

proved_lemmas: Lemma 1 (single-chord path creation): a chord (p_u,p_v), u<v, creates a simple a-y path of length L-(v-u)+1 where L is the path's edge count; equals 6 iff v-u=L-5, equals 14 iff v-u=L-13. General arithmetic identity, checked against every single-chord minimal witness found (no exceptions).

Lemma 2 (single-chord cycle creation): a chord (p_u,p_v) with v-u=15 closes a simple 16-cycle via the short arc plus the chord, independent of a,y,L. Observed twice in the data, both in gap1_e29 (L=17); never in the four L=18 families because the corresponding span-15 edges never occurred as edges there.

Lemma 3 (off-path vertices are chord-only): any off-path vertex has zero path edges, so its entire target degree is realized by chords, unconstrained by path-adjacency; restates degree bookkeeping already derived in type_b_order40_frontier.md.

empirical_findings.chord_count_of_minimal_witnesses: no fixed count works uniformly; ranges 1-9 for C16, 1-5 for length-6, 1-8 for length-14, depending on family (see md Section 3.1)
empirical_findings.exact_motif_fragmentation: 8289 distinct exact (position-canonicalized) C16 motifs, 242 length-6 motifs, 4196 length-14 motifs across 1936 candidates -- essentially no exact motif sharing once path position is accounted for
empirical_findings.off_path_hub_dependency_for_C16: at least one minimal C16 witness touches the off-path vertex in 54/54 (B20), 104/104 (gap2_e29), 296/296 (gap2_e30), 1080/1080 (gap1_e30), and 388/390 (gap1_e29, 2 exceptions) candidates -- near-universal but not strictly universal
empirical_findings.off_path_hub_dependency_for_closures: weaker and non-monotonic for length-6/length-14 closures; both off-path-touching and pure-path-only minimal witnesses coexist in most candidates (md Section 3.4)

hand_theorem_attempt.statement: Every completion of the specified path-degree system avoiding C4 and C8 contains C16 or an a-y path of length 6 or 14.
hand_theorem_attempt.status: TRUE on all 1936 examined candidates (in fact the stronger conjunctive form holds); NOT proved in general
obstacles_identified: no single motif or fixed chord count works uniformly across candidates (Section 3.1)
the near-universal C16/off-path-hub pattern has 2 known exceptions in gap1_e29, so it cannot ground an unconditional lemma without separately handling exceptional cases

failed_lemmas: every minimal C16 witness uses exactly 2 chords -- false, up to 9 chords observed
minimal length-6/length-14 witnesses never touch the off-path vertex -- false
every candidate has a single-chord length-6 closure path -- false, ranges 30%-100% of candidates by family
every minimal C16 witness touches the off-path vertex (strict universal) -- false, 2 exceptions in gap1_e29
a single-chord C16 witness (Lemma 2) occurs in every family -- false, only in gap1_e29
not_claimed: a general proof of the hand-theorem statement beyond the 1936 examined candidates
any conclusion about E=31 or higher edge counts
